cards.ex: We whiled away the afternoon playing board games.
cards.exUz: Biz tushdan keyin stol o'yinlarini o'ynab vaqt o'tkazdik.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtni qiziqarli yoki yoqimli tarzda o'tkazish, hech narsa qilmasdan.

cards.ex: He's a fair-weather fan; he only supports the team when they're winning.
cards.exUz: U bejirim muxlis; u faqat jamoa g'alaba qozonganida qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat jamoa g'alaba qozonganida muxlis bo'ladigan odam.

cards.ex: I like to dabble in photography in my spare time.
cards.exUz: Bo'sh vaqtimda fotografiya bilan qiziqib ko'rishni yoqtiraman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa bilan shug'ullanmoq, lekin jiddiy yoki muntazam ravishda emas.

cards.ex: He lives and breathes football; it's all he ever talks about.
cards.exUz: U futbol bilan yashab nafas oladi; u faqat shu haqida gapiradi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga juda qiziqish, butun hayoti shunga bag'ishlangan.

cards.ex: I need to get my fix of running every morning.
cards.exUz: Men har kuni ertalab yugurishdan dozamni olishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsadan zavqlanish uchun kerakli narsani olmoq, odatda qiziqish.

cards.ex: I need a vacation to recharge my batteries.
cards.exUz: Men kuch to'plash uchun ta'tilga borishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Dam olib, energiya tiklamoq, ayniqsa charchagandan keyin.

cards.ex: They went out to paint the town red after winning the championship.
cards.exUz: Ular chempionatda g'alaba qozonganlaridan keyin shaharda juda xursand bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Shahar bo'ylab ko'ngil ochmoq, juda xursand bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: I'm a bit of a homebody; I prefer staying in to going out.
cards.exUz: Men uyda bo'lishni afzal ko'radigan uychiman.
cards.uzDef: Uyda bo'lishni afzal ko'radigan odam.

cards.ex: My sister is a real shutterbug; she always has her camera with her.
cards.exUz: Singlim haqiqiy fotosuratchi; u doimo kamerasi bilan yuradi.
cards.uzDef: Fotosuratga tushishni juda yaxshi ko'radigan odam.

cards.ex: My travel plans are on the back burner for now.
cards.exUz: Mening sayohat rejalari hozircha keyinga qoldirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Hozircha muhim bo'lmagan yoki kechiktirilgan narsa.

cards.ex: It's easier to stay motivated with a workout buddy.
cards.exUz: Mashq sherigi bilan motivatsiyani saqlash osonroq.
cards.uzDef: Mashq qilishda birga bo'ladigan odam, motivatsiya uchun.

cards.ex: I lost track of time while reading that book.
cards.exUz: Men o'sha kitobni o'qiyotganda vaqtni unutdim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa bilan shunchalik mashg'ul bo'lishki, vaqtni unutish.

cards.ex: The game was a welcome distraction from all the stress at work.
cards.exUz: O'yin ishda bo'lgan barcha stressdan yoqimli chalg'itish edi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki zerikarli vaziyatdan chalg'itadigan narsa.

cards.ex: I have a soft spot for old movies.
cards.exUz: Men eski filmlarga mehr qo'yganman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga yoki kimgadir mehr qo'ymoq.

cards.ex: A weekend trip is a good change of scenery.
cards.exUz: Dam olish kunlari sayohati - bu yaxshi manzara o'zgarishi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi joyga borish yoki yangi narsani ko'rish.

cards.ex: Going for a run helps me get my mind off things.
cards.exUz: Yugurishga borish menga narsalarni unutishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani o'ylashni to'xtatishga yordam beradigan narsa.

cards.ex: I was glued to the TV during the Olympics.
cards.exUz: Men Olimpiya o'yinlari paytida televizorga yopishib qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Diqqat bilan kuzatmoq, qiziqib qolmoq.

cards.ex: We're having a social gathering at our house this weekend.
cards.exUz: Biz bu hafta oxiri uyimizda ijtimoiy yig'ilish o'tkazamiz.
cards.uzDef: Do'stlar yoki oila a'zolari bilan birga bo'lish.

cards.ex: Listening to music helps me take my mind off things.
cards.exUz: Musiqa tinglash menga fikrimni chalg'itishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Muammolarni unutishga yordam beradigan narsa qilmoq.

cards.ex: Volunteering at the animal shelter was a very rewarding experience.
cards.exUz: Hayvonlar boshpanasida ko'ngilli bo'lish juda qimmatli tajriba edi.
cards.uzDef: Qoniqish keltiradigan va foydali bo'lgan tajriba.

cards.ex: He's a great team player and always helps out his colleagues.
cards.exUz: U ajoyib jamoa a'zosi va doimo hamkasblariga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Jamoada yaxshi ishlaydigan odam.

cards.ex: I like to unwind with a good book after a long day.
cards.exUz: Men uzoq kundan keyin yaxshi kitob bilan dam olishni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Dam olmoq va stressdan xalos bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: I try to keep myself busy on the weekends so I don't get bored.
cards.exUz: Men dam olish kunlarida zerikmaslik uchun o'zimni band qilishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: O'zimni mashg'ul qiladigan narsalar bilan band bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: I like to test my limits by running longer distances.
cards.exUz: Men uzoqroq masofalarga yugurish orqali chegaralarimni sinab ko'rishni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: O'zimning qobiliyatlarimni yoki bardoshliligimni sinab ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: Sometimes it's good to unplug and recharge in nature.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan tabiatda uzilib quvvatlanish yaxshi.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyadan uzoqlashib, dam olmoq va kuch to'plamoq.

cards.ex: Yoga is a real stress-buster for me.
cards.exUz: Yoga men uchun haqiqiy stressni yo'qotuvchi.
cards.uzDef: Stressni kamaytirishga yordam beradigan narsa.

cards.ex: I'm going to take a shot at learning to play the guitar.
cards.exUz: Men gitarada o'ynashni o'rganishga urunib ko'rmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qilishga harakat qilmoq, urinib ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: Trying new things takes me out of my comfort zone.
cards.exUz: Yangi narsalarni sinab ko'rish meni qulaylik zonamdan tashqariga olib chiqadi.
cards.uzDef: O'zimni noqulay yoki notanish his qiladigan vaziyat.

cards.ex: Renovating the old house was a labor of love.
cards.exUz: Eski uyni ta'mirlash mehr bilan qilingan ish edi.
cards.uzDef: Pul uchun emas, balki zavq olish uchun qilingan ish.

cards.ex: Learning a new language can be a bit of a challenge.
cards.exUz: Yangi tilni o'rganish bir oz qiyinchilik bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Unchalik oson bo'lmagan, lekin qiziqarli narsa.
